anomalies.observed: The netlist includes both an ATtiny45 (U2) and an ATtiny13 (U3), and connects their corresponding supply, reset, and GPIO pins to the same nets. For example, both PB1 pins are on PWM, both PB2 pins are on SCK, and both PB0 pins are on SDA.
anomalies.expected: A fan controller should have one active MCU driving or sensing these shared control nets; if U2 and U3 are alternative assembly choices, only one should be fitted.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are fitted, they will run independently while sharing GPIO nets. Differences in timing or output state can cause contention on shared signals and make fan control or programming unreliable.

parsed.summary: The netlist contains two powered ATtiny MCUs whose corresponding GPIOs are connected in parallel. Unless one is explicitly excluded from assembly, this creates a credible risk of conflicting drivers in a design specified as a single ATtiny-driven fan controller.
